consequence.statement: The `secrets` list in `type: custom` authentication still works in this release but is deprecated and will be removed in the future.
consequence.remediation: Configure additional volumes through the template section instead of the `secrets` list.

assertion.statement: The `secrets` list used to mount additional Kubernetes Secrets in `type: custom` authentication is deprecated and will be removed in the future; additional volumes should be configured through the template section instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names the `secrets` list under `type: custom` authentication but not the custom resource kind or the full schema path, so a crd-field identity (group, kind, path) cannot be spelled from the text.; applicability: Without the owning resource kind and exact field path from the evidence, no resource/field predicate can be written for exposure.
